system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the distributed spanning tree construction algorithm. It extends the main specification and provides a concrete finite instantiation of the system parameters so that TLC can exhaustively explore the state space.
actors_and_components: The system inherits its actors from the base specification: a set of processes and a root process connected by a neighbor relation.
state_variables: No new state variables are introduced. All state variables come from the base specification.
initial_state: The initial state is inherited from the base specification.
actions: All actions are inherited from the base specification.
safety_properties: The model-checking configuration verifies type correctness and the sent-message property (processes without parents do not send messages).
model_bounds: The configuration uses three processes (identified as one, two, and three), with process one as the root. The neighbor relation is set to two directed edges: from process one to process two, and from process one to process three.
additional_assumptions: The termination and one-parent properties are commented out in the configuration file and are not checked in this model-checking setup.
